description: Third-party agent skills used locally alongside the skills published in this repo. They are NOT vendored here: each belongs to its original author, so this file records where to get it and how to update it.

installer.note: Installs into ~/.agents/skills. Each source below lists the skill names to pass via repeated -s flags.

sources.author: Paul Bakaus
sources.notes: Upstream ships a single 'impeccable' skill (v4.5.0 locally) that covers these as sub-commands, in reference/*.md. The standalone sibling directories are leftovers from an older layout and are no longer installable by name; impeccable supersedes them.

sources.author: Matt Pocock
sources.notes: All 38 upstream skills are installed. Six local names are outdated because upstream renamed or withdrew them: diagnose -> diagnosing-bugs, to-issues -> to-tickets, to-prd -> to-spec, write-a-skill -> writing-for-agents (via writing-great-skills). caveman and zoom-out were removed outright with no successor; the local copies still work but will not update. Update with 'npx skills@latest update -g -y', then re-link the harnesses. See AGENTS.md.

sources.author: Supabase
sources.notes: skill-creator was installed from this repo in Jan 2026 but is no longer published there; upstream now offers 'supabase' and 'supabase-postgres-best-practices'.

sources.author: Figma
sources.notes: No license file in the repository, so treat as all-rights-reserved. implement-design is no longer published; the closest successor is 'figma-design-to-code'.

sources.author: Steve Darlow
sources.notes: These skills are installed by the repository's own installer (python3 install.py), which targets ~/.claude/skills, ~/.codex/skills and ~/.agents/skills. Prefer that over 'npx skills add'. jev-compaction is skipped by the CLI because its frontmatter has a YAML parse error upstream; install.py copies it fine. 'npx skills add' also skips the whole repo when it hits that file.

sources.author: Notion Labs, Inc.
sources.notes: Official Notion skills repository. The local copy was an older revision. A same-named but unrelated community repo (CaesiumY/notion-cli-skill) also exists.

sources.author: intellectronica
sources.notes: Large multi-skill repo; only raindrop-api is used locally.

sources.author: Please Prompto!
sources.notes: The local notebooklm directory is empty.

sources.author: David Heinemeier Hansson
sources.notes: Skills that ship with the Omarchy Linux distribution (package: omarchy). Locally they are symlinked from /usr/share/omarchy/default/agents/skills into this store, so `omarchy update` keeps them current; the CLI install below is the portable path for machines without Omarchy. Upstream lives at github.com/basecamp/omarchy (the GitHub owner is omacom).
